notes.title: Update 1.1.3
notes.content:
As time goes by fast, it has been 1 year since we launched Kinduo on steam, our game is also available on consoles, we are very happy with our beloved game.
We made some small changes, to improve the experience with the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40608138/698821250b4b0afd111b38e673599132af1b0f58.png[/img]

- Added in the co-op screen, the 2 characters.
- Added steam username in the menu screen.
- Added controlling all menu screens with the gamepad analog.
- Added a sprite indicating the game mode when choosing solo or coop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40608138/377617186bcc5c3673754a63f0bfb97379a9d490.png[/img]

- In the phase 24 box drop correction colliders
- In the logo screen, you can now skip logos by pressing Start on the gamepad or Enter/Esc on the keyboard.

- When you choose to exit the game and come back, it will now return to the cursor position on exit.

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40608138/94e3676984946aee8e16d5e337e3e541747261d9.png[/img]

[b]Additions[/b]

- Fixed cloud bug in phase 10, which didn't move.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40608138/be5dd4379c6c37a1bc902de619da6051da1739e6.jpg[/img]

We thank everyone for the feedback we are getting, making it possible to improve the game even more.

We made some changes to the game, optimized the elevator, electrical box, doors, and minor bug fixes.

Additions
- Added thank you screen after finishing secret stage.

corrections
- Fixed bug where electric phased out by itself.

Improvements
- Increased the Rock's movement speed by 8%.
- Reprogrammed the secret stage camera so that it has a smoother movement.
- Improved elevator movement, now it has a fixed time and can be modified more easily.
- The electrical box is deactivated more quickly when the elevator reaches the end of the movement.
- The door now only opens 1 time, it is not closed, remaining open for the second character to enter.

tags.feature: - Added thank you screen after finishing secret stage.

tags.bug: - Fixed bug where electric phased out by itself.

tags.balance_change: - Increased the Rock's movement speed by 8%.

notes.title: Update 1.0.7
notes.content:
[b]Corrections[/b]
- Changed stage 21 tutorial board in solo mode, board displayed Z+X commands, changed to Up Arrow + Z, which is correct.
- Elevator now has the same ascent and descent speed all the time, we noticed that on some computers, the elevator was slower than it should have been, we reformulated the code so that it behaves the same for everyone, leaving the proper speed.

[b]Improvements[/b]
- Game menus and pause screen, can be moved with WASD.
- In stage 28, added snowman and a tree.

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
[b]Corrections[/b]
- Fixed the phase 20 bug where the clouds weren't moving.
- Fixed bug where the Rock when pushing the boxes touching the Electric, pushed it, making it cross objects.
- Fixed the Rock getting stuck when using the stomp attack on a box in some situations.
- Fixed bug when hitting the head in the elevator, when it goes down, now the character no longer grabs.
- After the player chooses the stage on the selection screen, it is no longer possible to move the selector.

[b]Improvements[/b]
- Increased the strength of the Rock jump from 460 to 480, facilitating jumps over boxes and short stomp.
- Improved stomp accuracy, enabling faster skip cancellation.

- Improved the design of the pipes that connect to the left electrical block of phases 13,14 and 20.
- Changed design of the sides of phase 20 and 23, thus avoiding accidental falls.
- Changed the design of the left side of phase 30, thus avoiding accidental falls.
- The game intro can always be seen when selecting the first phase of the game through the selection screen, but it can be skipped faster if the player wants.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.0.2[/b]

[b]Additions[/b]
- Animation by sound designer Liniker on the credits screen.
- Translated the achievements into Spanish, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese.

[b]Corrections[/b]
- When Rock was pushing a box and it was touching the wall or another box, he tried to run the pushing animation, now he doesn't start this animation in this condition.
- Fixed swap bug after one of the characters enters the door.

[b]Improvements[/b]
- Now after the character enters the door, control automatically passes to the remaining character on the screen.
- Shortened transition time between phases.
- Increased 5db in the dash sound.
- The skip-a-intro text only appears when the last frame enters the scene.
